question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"by".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition **"by" **is used to indicate the agent performing an action.
 
• In this case, the blank is followed by a verb, suggesting that the sentence requires an agent to complete the sentence.
 
• Therefore, **"by" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"In" **is used to indicate a location or time frame, which does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• **"Of" **is used to indicate possession or a relationship between two things, which also does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• **"At" **is used to indicate a specific location, which does not fit the sentence structure.
